# Job Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 421v–422r

---

**15:1** And-answered Elifaz [Eliphaz] the-Temanite and-said:

**15:2** "Will-a-wise-one [chacham] answer [ya'aneh] knowledge of-wind [da'at ruach], and-fill [vimalei] his-belly [bitno] [with the] east-wind [qadim]? **15:3** Arguing [hokheach] with-a-word [bedavar] [that] does-not profit [lo yiskon], and-speeches [umillin] [with which] he-does-not benefit [lo yo'il]?

**15:4** Indeed [af] you break-down [tafer] fear [yir'ah], and-you-diminish [vetigra] meditation [sichah] before [lifnei] God [el]. **15:5** For your-iniquity [avonkha] teaches [ye'allef] your-mouth [pikha], and-you-choose [vetivchar] the-tongue [leshon] of-the-crafty [arumim]. **15:6** Your-own-mouth [pikha] condemns-you [yarshi'akha], and-not I; and-your-lips [sefatekha] testify [ya'anu] against-you.

**15:7** [Were you] the-first [ha-rishon] man [adam] born [tivvaled]? Or-before [lifnei] the-hills [geva'ot] were-you-brought-forth [cholaleta]? **15:8** In-the-council [besod] of-God [eloah] did-you-listen [tishma]? And-did-you-limit [vetigra] to-yourself wisdom [chokhmah]?

**15:9** What do-you-know [yadeta] and-we-do-not know [velo neda]? [What] do-you-understand [tavin] and-it [is] not with-us [immanu]? **15:10** Both gray-haired [gam sav] and-aged [gam yashish] [are] among-us, greater [kabir] than-your-father [me-avikha] in-days.

**15:11** [Are] too-little [ham'at] for-you the-consolations [tanchumot] of-God [el], and-a-word [vedavar] spoken-gently [la'at] with-you? **15:12** Why does-your-heart [libbkha] carry-you-away [yiqqacheka], and-why do-your-eyes [einekha] flash [yirzemun]? **15:13** For you-turn [tashiv] against God [el] your-spirit [ruchekha], and-you-bring-out [vehotsetsa] from-your-mouth [mippikha] words [millin].

**15:14** What [is] man [enosh] that-he-should-be-clean [yizkeh]? And-that-he-should-be-righteous [yitsdaq], one-born of-woman [yelud ishah]? **15:15** Behold, in-his-holy-ones [biqedoshav] he-does-not trust [lo ya'amin], and-the-heavens [shamayim] are-not pure [lo zakku] in-his-eyes [be-einav]. **15:16** How-much-less [af ki] one-abhorrent [nit'av] and-corrupt [ne'elach], a-man [ish] who-drinks [shoteh] injustice [avlah] like-water [kamayim].

**15:17** I-will-declare [achaveka] to-you — hear [shema] me; and-what I-have-seen [chaziti] I-will-recount [va'asapperah]. **15:18** What wise-men [chakhamim] tell [yaggidu], and-did-not hide [velo kichedu] from-their-fathers [me-avotam]. **15:19** To-them alone was-the-land [ha-arets] given, and-no stranger [zar] passed among-them.

**15:20** All the-days of-the-wicked [rasha] he writhes [mitcholel], and-the-number of-years [shanim] stored-up [nitspenu] for-the-ruthless [le'arits]. **15:21** A-sound of-terrors [pachad] [is] in-his-ears; in-prosperity [bashalom] a-destroyer [shoded] will-come-upon-him. **15:22** He-does-not believe [lo ya'amin] to-return [lashuv] from-darkness [mini choshekh], and-he [is] watched [tsafuv] for the-sword [cherev].

**15:23** He-wanders [noded] for-bread [la-lechem] — where [ayeh]? He-knows [yada] that prepared [nakhon] in-his-hand [beyado] [is] a-day of-darkness [choshekh]. **15:24** Distress [tsar] and-anguish [metsuqah] terrify-him [yeva'atuhu]; they-overpower-him [titkephehu] like-a-king [ke-melekh] prepared [atid] for-battle [le-kidor].

**15:25** For he-stretched-out [natah] against God [el] his-hand [yado], and-against Shaddai [the-Almighty] he-acts-defiantly [yitgabbar]. **15:26** He-runs [yaruts] against-him with-a-neck [be-tsavvar], with-the-thick [ba-avi] bosses [gabbei] of-his-shields [maginno].

**15:27** For he-covered [kissah] his-face [panav] with-his-fat [bechelbo], and-he-made [vaya'as] fat [pimah] upon [his] loins [kesil]. **15:28** And-he-dwelled [vayyishkon] [in] cities [arim] cut-off [nikhchadot], houses [battim] [where] none-would-dwell [lo yeshvu], that were-destined [hit'atdu] for-heaps [le-gallin].

**15:29** He-will-not be-rich [lo ye'eshar], and-his-wealth [chelo] will-not endure [lo yaqum], and-their-possessions [minlatam] will-not spread [lo yitteh] over-the-earth [la-arets]. **15:30** He-will-not depart [lo yasur] from-darkness [mini choshekh]; his-shoot [yonaqto] a-flame [shalhebet] will-dry-up [tetayesh], and-he-will-depart [veyasar] by-the-breath [be-ruach] of-his-mouth [piv].

**15:31** Let-him-not trust [al ya'amen] in-emptiness [bashshav], being-deceived [nit'ah]; for emptiness [shav] will-be his-reward [temurato]. **15:32** Before [belo] his-day [yomo] it-will-be-completed [timmale], and-his-branch [vekippato] will-not be-green [lo ra'ananah]. **15:33** He-will-shake-off [yachmos] like-the-vine [ka-gafen] his-unripe-fruit [bissero], and-he-will-cast-off [veyashlekh] like-the-olive-tree [ka-zayit] his-blossom [nitstsato].

**15:34** For the-company [adat] of-the-godless [chanef] [is] barren [galmud], and-fire [esh] consumes [akhlah] the-tents of-bribery [shochad]. **15:35** They-conceive [haro] trouble [amal] and-bring-forth [velod] wickedness [aven], and-their-belly [bitmam] prepares [takhin] deceit [mirmah]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — "the first man born":** Eliphaz's rhetoric — were you the primordial Adam? Did you sit in God's council? The allusion may be to a tradition of a "first man" who possessed divine wisdom (cf. Ezekiel 28:12-15; Proverbs 8:22-31).

**v.14-16 — Human impurity:** Eliphaz escalates his earlier argument (4:17-19). Even the heavenly beings (*qedoshim*) are not pure in God's eyes — how much less a human who "drinks injustice like water." The image is of compulsive, thirst-driven sin.

**v.26 — "with a neck, with the thick bosses of his shields":** The image is of a warrior charging God with a heavy shield held out in front — a posture of aggressive defiance, not defense.

**v.35 — "conceive trouble, bring forth wickedness":** The pregnancy metaphor for evil recurs in Scripture (cf. Psalm 7:14; Isaiah 59:4). Sin begins as conception (internal) and results in birth (external manifestation).

*— EMET*
